question: Should Control UI add a dedicated expanded composer modal for long prompts, or should the current inline autogrow textarea plus configurable send shortcut remain the intended long-prompt path?
rationale: The requested modal workflow is still missing and likely useful, but it adds a second composition mode whose draft, focus, attachment, and send semantics should be chosen by a Control UI owner before automation builds it.

options.title: Approve Expanded Composer Modal
options.body: Implement an explicit modal editor with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, attachment handling, and modal-only Enter/Ctrl-or-Cmd+Enter behavior.

options.title: Prefer Inline Composer
options.body: Treat the existing autogrow textarea and modifier-send setting as the intended long-prompt solution, then close or narrow this request.

options.title: Decline Modal Direction
options.body: Close the request by maintainer decision if the Control UI composer should stay lean and modal composition should not live in core.

recommendation.title: Approve Expanded Composer Modal
recommendation.body: Implement an explicit modal editor with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, attachment handling, and modal-only Enter/Ctrl-or-Cmd+Enter behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has both recent adjacent send-shortcut ownership and prior issue-review context for this long-prompt composer UX.
